s0401.literal: On jichou day Vice Minister of War Huo'er Tuohua and others were dispatched as envoys to the three states of Gelang, Kernada, and Sinhenatiyin; a three-pearl tiger tally was also granted to the chief of Sinhenatiyin.
s0401.idiomatic: On jichou day Vice Minister of War Huo'er Tuohua and others were dispatched as envoys to Gelang, Kernada, and Sinhenatiyin; a three-pearl tiger tally was also granted to the chief of Sinhenatiyin.

s0402.literal: On gengyin day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0402.idiomatic: On gengyin day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0403.literal: A comet entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, reaching the Dipper Head; its light was about a foot long; after one month it vanished.
s0403.idiomatic: A comet entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, reaching the Dipper Head; its light was about a foot long, and after one month it vanished.

s0404.literal: On bingshen day Mars transgressed Kang.
s0404.idiomatic: On bingshen day Mars transgressed Kang.

s0405.literal: On jihai day the moon transgressed Tianguan.
s0405.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon transgressed Tianguan.

s0406.literal: On xinchou day the moon transgressed Well.
s0406.idiomatic: On xinchou day the moon transgressed Well.

s0407.literal: An edict ordered reduction of rice prices; rice was sold to famine victims in the capital, and widowed, orphaned, solitary, and destitute persons unable to support themselves were given provisions.
s0407.idiomatic: An edict ordered rice prices reduced; rice was sold to famine victims in the capital, and widowed, orphaned, solitary, and destitute persons unable to support themselves were given provisions.

s0408.literal: On jiachen day an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0408.idiomatic: On jiachen day an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0409.literal: On wushen day monk officials from president and below who had wives were dismissed.
s0409.idiomatic: On wushen day monk officials from president and below who had wives were dismissed.

s0410.literal: Duan Zhen was promoted to grand councillor for supervising the river-opening and granary-repair projects.
s0410.idiomatic: Duan Zhen was promoted to grand councillor for supervising the river-opening and granary-repair projects.

s0411.literal: On gengxu day elephant hoof shoes and palm armor were made.
s0411.idiomatic: On gengxu day elephant hoof shoes and palm armor were made.

s0412.literal: On xinhai day it was forbidden in Jiangnan prefectures and commanderies to beg and raise good-family children and resell them in succession, or forcibly to seize and sell commoners.
s0412.idiomatic: On xinhai day it was forbidden in Jiangnan prefectures and commanderies to beg and raise good-family children and resell them in succession, or forcibly to seize and sell commoners.

s0413.literal: Pingluan suffered flooding; eleven thousand nine hundred seventy-seven shi of field rent were remitted.
s0413.idiomatic: Pingluan suffered flooding; 11,977 shi of field rent were remitted.

s0414.literal: The Guangji Agency suffered flooding; one hundred sixty-five qing of garrison farms were damaged, and six thousand two hundred thirteen shi of field rent were remitted.
s0414.idiomatic: The Guangji Agency suffered flooding; 165 qing of garrison farms were damaged, and 6,213 shi of field rent were remitted.

s0415.literal: Eleventh month, on the renzi new moon, De'an Prefecture was placed under Huangzhou Route.
s0415.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renzi new moon, De'an Prefecture was placed under Huangzhou Route.

s0416.literal: On dingsi day Sun Minxian had once attached himself to Sangge, helped Yaoshumu do evil, and as associate administrator of the Shangdu garrison headquarters had also taken bribes and reduced the grain rations of attendant officials; an edict ordered registration of his household property, wife, and slaves;
s0416.idiomatic: On dingsi day Sun Minxian had once attached himself to Sangge, helped Yaoshumu do evil, and as associate administrator of the Shangdu garrison headquarters had also taken bribes and reduced the grain rations of attendant officials; an edict ordered registration of his household property, wife, and slaves;

s0417.literal: also because Tanzhou's Lü Ze impeached him for cruelty, Minxian was sent in fetters to Huguang and fully investigated according to Ze's charges.
s0417.idiomatic: Also because Tanzhou's Lü Ze impeached him for cruelty, Minxian was sent in fetters to Huguang and fully investigated according to Ze's charges.

s0418.literal: The Haibei-Hainan Circuit rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commission was established, seated at Leizhou.
s0418.idiomatic: The Haibei-Hainan Circuit rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commission was established, seated at Leizhou.

s0419.literal: On gengshen day an edict instructed the Central Secretariat that for all troops on campaign, their families were not to be troubled with government hire and government purchase.
s0419.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict instructed the central secretariat that for all troops on campaign, their families were not to be troubled with government hire and government purchase.

s0420.literal: On yichou day the moon transgressed Bi.
s0420.idiomatic: On yichou day the moon transgressed Bi.

s0421.literal: On yimao day the moon transgressed Well.
s0421.idiomatic: On yimao day the moon transgressed Well.

s0422.literal: On wuchen day, because the registered households of Jinchi Muduo had increased, a lower-route chief prefecture was established, and its leading chieftain was granted a double-pearl tiger tally.
s0422.idiomatic: On wuchen day, because the registered households of Jinchi Muduo had increased, a lower-route chief prefecture was established, and its leading chieftain was granted a double-pearl tiger tally.

s0423.literal: Hesan, darughachi of Zhending Route, said: "Surveillance commission officials audit civilian officials too harshly; we request that civilian officials be allowed to audit surveillance commission records in return.
s0423.idiomatic: Hesan, darughachi of Zhending Route, said, "Surveillance commission officials audit civilian officials too harshly; we request that civilian officials be allowed to audit surveillance commission records in return.

s0425.literal: On gengwu day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0425.idiomatic: On gengwu day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0426.literal: The military artisans of Jiangnan's Capital Construction Directorate were exempted from campaign service.
s0426.idiomatic: The military artisans of Jiangnan's Capital Construction Directorate were exempted from campaign service.

s0427.literal: On bingzi day Mars transgressed Hooked Clasp.
s0427.idiomatic: On bingzi day Mars transgressed Hooked Clasp.

s0428.literal: On wuyin day Jupiter transgressed Kang.
s0428.idiomatic: On wuyin day Jupiter transgressed Kang.

s0429.literal: On jimao day Bayan, grand councillor of the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat, entered office as grand councillor of the Central Secretariat, ranking above Tiege, Cizhen, and Buqumu.
s0429.idiomatic: On jimao day Bayan, grand councillor of the Henan-Jiangbei branch secretariat, entered office as grand councillor of the central secretariat, ranking above Tiege, Cizhen, and Buqumu.

s0430.literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai day, Han troops on rotation were forbidden to sell military equipment.
s0430.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dinghai day, Han troops on rotation were forbidden to sell military equipment.

s0431.literal: Tahai, darughachi of Wuping Route, said: "The Jurchen lands remain unsettled to this day; when a single bandit enters, the people scatter; your subject wishes to go pacify and gather them.
s0431.idiomatic: Tahai, darughachi of Wuping Route, said, "The Jurchen lands remain unsettled to this day; when a single bandit enters, the people scatter; your subject wishes to go pacify and gather them.

s0432.literal: " An edict made Tahai Liaodong Circuit pacification commissioner.
s0432.idiomatic: " An edict made Tahai Liaodong Circuit pacification commissioner.

s0433.literal: On renchen day left associate administrator of the Central Secretariat Ma Shao fell ill; Judicial Steward Zhang Jiusi replaced him.
s0433.idiomatic: On renchen day left associate administrator of the central secretariat Ma Shao fell ill; judicial steward Zhang Jiusi replaced him.

s0434.literal: On yiwei day the moon transgressed Well.
s0434.idiomatic: On yiwei day the moon transgressed Well.

s0435.literal: Envoys were dispatched to supervise Si and Bo prefectures and Zhenyuan and Huangping, mobilizing eight thousand men of the old Song army to follow the campaign against Annam.
s0435.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to supervise Si and Bo prefectures and Zhenyuan and Huangping, mobilizing 8,000 men of the old Song army to follow the campaign against Annam.

s0436.literal: On gengzi day grand councillors Yisihanshi, Shi Bi, and Gao Xing and others returned without achievement; each was flogged and publicly shamed, and one-third of their household property was confiscated.
s0436.idiomatic: On gengzi day grand councillors Yisihanshi, Shi Bi, and Gao Xing and others returned without achievement; each was flogged and publicly shamed, and one-third of their household property was confiscated.

s0437.literal: On guimao day an edict ordered that three hundred ninety-one qing and eighty-odd mu of official fields confiscated from Sangge be granted to the artisan households under Ahe'uwlan's supervision.
s0437.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict ordered that 391 qing and 80-odd mu of official fields confiscated from Sangge be granted to the artisan households under Ahe'uwlan's supervision.

s0438.literal: On bingwu day Tiechi, Tuotuomu'er, Yaozhu, and Baiyan — four men — were all made tutors to the Prince of Anxi.
s0438.idiomatic: On bingwu day Tiechi, Tuotuomu'er, Yaozhu, and Baiyan — four men — were all made tutors to the Prince of Anxi.

s0439.literal: That year, throughout the realm there were two thousand thirty-eight routes, prefectures, subprefectures, and counties in all: one hundred sixty-nine routes, forty-three prefectures, three hundred ninety-eight subprefectures, one thousand one hundred sixty-five counties, fifteen pacification commissions, one pacification commissionerate, eleven stockades, one garrison-and-pacification office, one fort, seventy-three native officials administering both military and civilian affairs in the various dian districts, fifty-one native chieftain offices, one hundred three record-keeping offices, and three patrol stations.
s0439.idiomatic: That year, throughout the realm there were 2,038 routes, prefectures, subprefectures, and counties in all: 169 routes, 43 prefectures, 398 subprefectures, 1,165 counties, 15 pacification commissions, 1 pacification commissionerate, 11 stockades, 1 garrison-and-pacification office, 1 fort, 73 native officials administering both military and civilian affairs in the various dian districts, 51 native chieftain offices, 103 record-keeping offices, and 3 patrol stations.

s0440.literal: Government offices large and small numbered two thousand seven hundred thirty-three; those attending court, two hundred twenty-one;
s0440.idiomatic: Government offices large and small numbered 2,733; those attending court, 221;

s0441.literal: and posts, sixteen thousand four hundred twenty-five; those attending court, one thousand six hundred eighty-four.

s0442.literal: Households numbered fourteen million two thousand seven hundred sixty.

s0443.literal: The empress, imperial princes, and princesses were granted gifts as in the annual precedent.
s0443.idiomatic: The empress, imperial princes, and princesses were granted gifts as in the annual precedent.

s0444.literal: Sheep and horse prices were granted to various ministers — four hundred thirty-four thousand five hundred ingots of notes and fifty-five thousand four hundred ten ingots of silks.
s0444.idiomatic: Sheep and horse prices were granted to various ministers — 434,500 ingots of notes and 55,410 ingots of silks.

s0445.literal: To relieve the poor, thirty-seven thousand five hundred twenty ingots of notes were granted.
s0445.idiomatic: To relieve the poor, 37,520 ingots of notes were granted.

s0446.literal: Fifty-one Buddhist rites for blessing were performed.
s0446.idiomatic: 51 Buddhist rites for blessing were performed.

s0447.literal: Twenty-nine places including Zhending and Ningjin suffered disasters of flood, drought, locusts, or hail.
s0447.idiomatic: 29 places including Zhending and Ningjin suffered disasters of flood, drought, locusts, or hail.

s0448.literal: Forty persons were sentenced to death.

s0449.literal: Thirty-first year, spring, first month, on the renzi new moon, the Emperor was unwell and court congratulations were waived.
s0449.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, on the renzi new moon of the first month of spring, the Emperor was unwell and court congratulations were waived.

s0450.literal: On guihai day Bayan, overseer of the Privy Council, arrived from the army.
s0450.idiomatic: On guihai day Bayan, overseer of the privy council, arrived from the army.

s0451.literal: On gengwu day the Emperor grew gravely ill.
s0451.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor grew gravely ill.

s0452.literal: On guiyou day the Emperor died in the Zitan Hall.
s0452.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor died in the Zitan Hall.

s0453.literal: He had reigned thirty-five years and lived to eighty.
s0453.idiomatic: He had reigned 35 years and lived to 80.

s0454.literal: Princes and major ministers dispatched envoys to announce mourning to the imperial grandson.
s0454.idiomatic: Princes and major ministers dispatched envoys to announce mourning to the imperial grandson.

s0455.literal: On yihai day the imperial bier set out; he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
s0455.idiomatic: On yihai day the imperial bier set out; he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

s0456.literal: Summer, fourth month, the imperial grandson arrived at Shangdu.
s0456.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, the imperial grandson arrived at Shangdu.

s0457.literal: On jiawu day he ascended the imperial throne.
s0457.idiomatic: On jiawu day he ascended the imperial throne.

s0458.literal: On bingwu day Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Wanze and the civil and military officials deliberated on conferring a posthumous honorific title.
s0458.idiomatic: On bingwu day Right Chancellor of the central secretariat Wanze and the civil and military officials deliberated on conferring a posthumous honorific title.

s0459.literal: On renyin day an altar was first established seven li south of the capital.
s0459.idiomatic: On renyin day an altar was first established seven li south of the capital.

s0460.literal: On jiachen day Grand Preceptor Udutai, Grand Councillor Buqumu, and Left Associate Administrator Zhang Jiusi were dispatched to lead all officials in requesting a posthumous title at the Southern Suburb.
s0460.idiomatic: On jiachen day Grand Preceptor Udutai, Grand Councillor Buqumu, and Left Associate Administrator Zhang Jiusi were dispatched to lead all officials in requesting a posthumous title at the Southern Suburb.

s0461.literal: Fifth month, on wuwu day Acting Grand Preceptor Udutai was dispatched to present the register and confer the honorific title Emperor Sacred in Virtue, Divine in Achievement, Martial and Civil; the temple name was Shizu, and in the national language he was styled Emperor Setsen.
s0461.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuwu day Acting Grand Preceptor Udutai was dispatched to present the register and confer the honorific title Emperor Sacred in Virtue, Divine in Achievement, Martial and Civil; the temple name was Shizu, and in the national language he was styled Emperor Setsen.

s0462.literal: That day Wanze and others likewise deliberated and conferred on the late empress of the Onggirat clan the honorific title Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng.
s0462.idiomatic: That day Wanze and others likewise deliberated and conferred on the late empress of the Onggirat clan the honorific title Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng.

s0463.literal: Shizu was broad in measure, knew men and employed them well, trusted Confucian learning, and by these means was able to transform the barbarians through Chinese ways; in establishing classics and setting forth regulations, the institutions of his age were grand and far-reaching.
s0463.idiomatic: Shizu was magnanimous in spirit, knew men and employed them well, trusted Confucian learning, and thereby transformed the barbarians through Chinese ways; the institutions he established for his age were grand and far-reaching.
